title: Add NeuralCanvas to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [NeuralCanvas](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.proApps.aiimagegenerator) to image
- NeuralCanvas is a native Android app (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose) that turns a text prompt into an AI-generated image, built entirely on the Pollinations image API. How it uses Pollinations: every gener

Fixes #13448

gist.headline: A canvas in your pocket
gist.blurb: NeuralCanvas has joined the garden: an Android app that turns a few words into images using the Pollinations API. Your phone was already full of prompts anyway.
gist.summary: Added NeuralCanvas to the app directory, a native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose Android app that generates AI images from text prompts through the Pollinations image API.
gist.impact: Android users now have a discoverable mobile example of a complete image-generation app built directly on Pollinations, from prompt to pixels.
gist.visual_concept: Depict NeuralCanvas as a cozy Android phone-sized canvas blooming with a generated pastel landscape. Polli, wearing a tiny painter's beret, taps a prompt into the phone while pixel flowers and code-plants grow from the screen, showing that a simple mobile prompt becomes an image through the API.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown stripes, black antennae, black oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blush, happy smile, and rounded light-blue translucent wings, wearing a tiny painter's beret as she taps a text prompt into a large Android phone that blooms into a pastel pixel landscape and code-flowers. The phone screen glows prominently lime green (#ecf874), with a tiny retro terminal and garden vines nearby; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with pixel-font text: 'NEURALCANVAS'.
